assumptions: one worker, one replica, no autoscaling; memory-backed job/idempotency state
label: phase-8-face-job-idempotency
newCases: same idempotency key returns same accepted job without consuming second upload
job creation without idempotency key rejected before request body read
coldStart: Client health warm-up and bounded retry already existed; no Android cold-start integration run in this pass
approach: Client generates one key per job-creation operation and reuses it across transport retries; service maps authenticated owner plus key to existing in-process job
